name: The Springs Resort & Spa

address.street: 9 Km Oeste y km 4 Norte del centro de la Fortuna

insider_take: Nestled in the shadow of Costa Rica's iconic Arenal Volcano, this eco-luxury retreat offers front-row seats to one of nature's most spectacular shows.
whats_special: The Springs features 18 natural hot spring pools cascading down the mountainside, each offering different temperatures and mineral compositions. The property sits on 165 acres of pristine rainforest where you can spot over 300 bird species, including the resplendent quetzal. Their Adventure Center provides direct access to zip-lining, wildlife safaris, and hiking trails leading to hidden waterfalls.
pro_tip: Book a villa with volcano views and time your arrival for the dry season (December-April) when Arenal's peak is most visible and volcanic activity can be observed at night.
dont_miss: The sunset soak in Pool #1 with unobstructed Arenal Volcano views, and the guided night walk to witness the famous red lava flows illuminating the sky. The on-site Wildlife Preserve houses rescued animals including jaguars, pumas, and exotic birds that can't be released back into the wild.
pros: Natural hot springs with volcano views of Arenal
Multiple pools and thermal spring experiences
Prime location for adventure activities and nature tours
cons: Remote rainforest location requires transportation planning
Premium pricing for spa and thermal spring access
